signals.title: Shake That Hill: Eldoria 2026 Festival
signals.reason: Open-air hill festival with dedicated daytime kids' play zones, craft stalls, and spacious green areas for running around.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and livepass.bg for August 28–30, 2026.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: Expansive outdoor museum featuring dozens of real planes and helicopters to explore with plenty of space for a toddler to roam.

signals.title: Keffa Children's Farm
signals.reason: Hands-on, gentle farm animal encounters with sheep, cows, and donkeys tailored specifically for preschoolers.

signals.title: Bubbu Bear Children's Center Park Zone
signals.reason: Secure outdoor park zone with inflatables and play equipment that lets a 4-year-old burn energy safely.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Chuk & Puk (Чук и Пук)
signals.reason: Humorous and educational morning puppet performance perfectly timed and themed for preschool children.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com for September 19, 2026 at State Puppet Theatre Plovdiv.

signals.title: Plovdiv Old Town Celebrations 2026
signals.location: Old Town squares (Lapidarium, Balabanov House), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Festive atmosphere in the historic area with hands-on craft workshops, open-air music, and kid-friendly cultural activities.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and Old Town Plovdiv official calendar for September 16–23, 2026.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Thumbelina (Палечка)
signals.reason: Classic fairy tale puppet show designed for toddlers and preschoolers in a comfortable morning setting.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and grabo.bg for September 26, 2026 at State Puppet Theatre Plovdiv.

signals.title: 19th PolineROOOCK Festival (Headlined by Ronnie Romero)
signals.when_text: Friday to Sunday, August 28–30, 2026 (Headliner on Sunday from 18:00)
signals.location: Bunardzhika Summer Theatre (Летен театър Бунарджик), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Open-air classic rock and metal festival in the Bunardzhik park setting, featuring international vocalist Ronnie Romero (Rainbow, MSG) performing in English.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and marica.bg for August 28–30, 2026.

signals.title: Shake That Hill 2026: Eldoria Open-Air Music & Arts Festival
signals.reason: Popular multi-stage late-summer outdoor festival featuring live electronic, indie and world music acts, craft food, and relaxed hill park atmosphere.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and livepass.bg for August 28–30, 2026.

signals.title: National Autumn Exhibitions 2026: 'Mirrors of the City' (Огледала на града)
signals.when_text: Opening Tuesday, September 1, 2026 at 18:00 (Runs through September)
signals.location: Lapidarium (Atanas Krastev Sq.) and historic Old Town courtyards, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Curated annual visual arts program turning Old Town courtyards into open exhibition spaces with contemporary painting, photography, and installations by prominent female artists.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and visitplovdiv.com for opening September 1, 2026.

signals.title: Opera Open 2026: Tchaikovsky's 'Swan Lake' Ballet
signals.location: Ancient Theatre (Античен театър), Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Full classical ballet performance staged by State Opera Plovdiv under the stars at the Roman amphitheatre; purely visual and non-verbal.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and operaplovdiv.bg for September 4, 2026.

signals.title: Olvido Ruiz & Daniel Stawinski – 'The Voice of Cuba' Latin Jazz Concert
signals.location: Malkite Konyushni Outdoor Stage (Малките конюшни), Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Intimate open-air Latin jazz and Havana son concert presented by Cuban vocalist Olvido Ruiz and pianist Daniel Stawinski on the Chamber Stage platform.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and kapana.bg for September 15, 2026 at Malkite Konyushni stage.

signals.title: Septicflesh with Orchestra & Choir: 'Ancient Whispers'
signals.location: Ancient Theatre (Античен театър), Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Exclusive full symphonic metal production featuring live choir and classical orchestra in the Roman amphitheatre setting.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and visitplovdiv.com for September 19, 2026.

signals.title: LUCKY House of Cinema: Subtitled Original Audio Screenings
signals.location: LUCKY House of Cinema, 1 William Gladstone St, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Central boutique cinema showing international film releases in their original audio with Bulgarian subtitles rather than local dubbing.

signals.title: Major Traffic Shutdown for Botev Plovdiv vs. Levski Sofia Football Match
signals.location: Hristo Botev Stadium area: Iztochen Blvd, Bogomil St, Lev Tolstoy St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Complete police closure of major central-east thoroughfares (Iztochen Blvd between Knyaginya Maria Luiza and Sankt Peterburg Blvd) causing substantial city traffic delays and bus route detours.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and marica.bg for August 30, 2026.

signals.title: Road Closure and Bus Rerouting on 6th September Boulevard
signals.location: 6th September Blvd (between Vladivostok St. and Turgenev St.), West Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major arterial boulevard closed to vehicular traffic for EVN district heating network expansion and water main replacement; local public transit lines diverted.
signals.note: Confirmed on podtepeto.com and EVN official announcements for closures through September 14, 2026.

signals.title: Emergency Water Outage on Central Plovdiv Streets
signals.location: Sv. Kliment St, Dragan Tsankov St, and Peshtersko Shosse Blvd, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Unplanned municipal water supply cut-off affecting central residential blocks due to pipe failures and contractor waterline connection work.
signals.note: dropped: ended 2026-08-28, before window opens 2026-08-29; Confirmed on vik.bg official outages listing for August 28, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Airport: 8 New Direct European Flight Routes Announced
signals.reason: Carrier announced plans for twice-weekly direct flights connecting Plovdiv directly to destinations in 8 countries (including Germany, Spain, France, and the Netherlands).
signals.note: Confirmed on bnr.bg and marica.bg via Plovdiv Airport director announcement on August 27, 2026.
